description: This is a source file implementing various functions for parsing and forming requests and responses in a C-based project related to WDMP (Wireless Device Management Protocol). It includes functions for parsing JSON payloads, forming JSON responses, and freeing allocated structures.

methods.name: void wdmp_parse_generic_request(char * payload,PAYLOAD_TYPE payload_type,req_struct ** reqObj)
methods.description: Parses a JSON payload to determine the request type and populate the request structure accordingly. Handles different command types such as GET, SET, TEST_AND_SET, etc.

methods.name: void wdmp_parse_request(char * payload,req_struct ** reqObj)
methods.description: Wrapper function that calls wdmp_parse_generic_request with a fixed payload type.

methods.name: void wdmp_form_response(res_struct * resObj,char ** payload)
methods.description: Creates a JSON response payload based on the response object provided, handling various response types.

methods.name: void wdmp_free_req_struct(req_struct * reqObj)
methods.description: Frees memory allocated within a request structure, depending on its request type.

methods.name: void wdmp_free_res_struct(res_struct * resObj)
methods.description: Frees memory allocated within a response structure, depending on its response type.
